name: Facet
text: Ship the live HTML/CSS prototype tonight. Real API calls expose performance bottlenecks faster than mocks, forcing us to solve real latency and data shape issues early. The trade-off is higher upfront effort, but it cuts weeks of rework later when we discover the API can’t deliver the speed we need.

name: Pane
text: Shipping a live HTML/CSS prototype tonight could lead to exposing design weaknesses rather than solving real issues. If the actual API response is inconsistent or poorlystructured, it risks creating a false sense of confidence in performance. A better alternative is to utilize a well-defined mock API that closely mirrors expected behavior, allowing us to iterate on the interface clarity and enjoyment without being hindered by backend uncertainties. To settle this, we need a demonstration of how effectively a mock can represent the API's fluctuating performance before committing to a live prototype.
